  <!-- Drawer joints (sliding toward front, i.e., decreasing Y since front is -Y)
       Drawer travel range: 0 to 0.25 m outward (toward -Y) -->
  <!-- Drawer stack height available above base: total height 1.21m; base 0.10m; leaving 1.10m.
       5 drawers stacked => 1.10/5 = 0.22m pitch. Drawer thickness 0.18m leaving ~0.04m clearance.
       Drawer centers in Z:
         drawer_1 center z = 0.10 + (0.22*0 + 0.11) = 0.21
         drawer_2 center z = 0.10 + (0.22*1 + 0.11) = 0.43
         drawer_3 center z = 0.10 + (0.22*2 + 0.11) = 0.65
         drawer_4 center z = 0.10 + (0.22*3 + 0.11) = 0.87
         drawer_5 center z = 0.10 + (0.22*4 + 0.11) = 1.09
       Drawer link frame origin placed at drawer center at Y=0 when fully retracted? We'll set joint origin so that
       drawer link box center is at Y = -0.03 when retracted (near back) and moves toward -Y with joint.
       Choose retracted drawer center Y0 = 0.08 (back toward +Y), then outward decreases Y.
       With drawer depth 0.41, half-depth 0.205. Back inner cavity approx up to y=+0.235-0.02=+0.215,
       front cavity approx down to y=-0.215. Set retracted center at y=+0.10 gives front face at -0.105.
       We'll implement via joint origin and limits; the drawer link itself is defined with its box centered at its link origin.
  -->
